  GROUP BY qo.customer_id
)
SELECT
  c.segment,
  SUM(nr.gross_revenue - nr.total_refunds) AS net_revenue
FROM net_revenue nr
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON nr.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment

WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01'
    AND order_date <= '2026-03-31'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1
),
q1_2026_orders AS (
  SELECT
    o.customer_id,
    oi.order_item_id,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price_gross,
    oi.discount_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01'
    AND o.order_date <= '2026-03-31'
    AND o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM repeat_customers)
),
returns_q1_2026 AS (
  SELECT
    r.order_item_id,
    r.refund_amount
  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  WHERE r.return_date >= '2026-01-01'
    AND r.return_date <= '2026-03-31'
),
net_revenue_per_item AS (
  SELECT
    qo.customer_id,
    (qo.quantity * qo.unit_price_gross - qo.discount_amount) - COALESCE(r.refund_amount, 0) AS net_revenue
  FROM q1_2026_orders qo
  LEFT JOIN returns_q1_2026 r ON qo.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
)
SELECT
  c.segment,
  SUM(nri.net_revenue) AS net_revenue
FROM net_revenue_per_item nri
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c ON nri.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY c.segment

WITH repeat_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM ecom_v1.orders
  WHERE order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) > 1
),
monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    d.month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_gross - oi.discount_amount) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN ecom_v1.dim_date d
    ON o.order_date = d.date_key
  JOIN repeat_customers rc
    ON o.customer_id = rc.customer_id
  WHERE d.year = 2024
    AND o.order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY d.month
)
SELECT
  month,
  net_revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
ORDER BY month;

WITH net_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    oi.order_id,
    oi.product_id,
    oi.quantity,
    oi.unit_price_gross,
    oi.discount_amount,
    oi.tax_rate,
    r.quantity_returned
  FROM ecom_v1.order_items oi
  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns r
    ON oi.order_item_id = r.order_item_id
),
channel_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    c.channel_type,
    SUM(
      (nr.quantity - COALESCE(nr.quantity_returned, 0))
      * (nr.unit_price_gross - nr.discount_amount)
      / (1 + nr.tax_rate)
    ) AS net_revenue
  FROM ecom_v1.orders o
  JOIN ecom_v1.channels c
    ON o.channel_id = c.channel_id
  JOIN net_revenue nr
    ON o.order_id = nr.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status = 'completed'
  GROUP BY c.channel_type
)
SELECT
  channel_type,
  net_revenue
FROM channel_revenue
ORDER BY net_revenue ASC
LIMIT 1;

  LEFT JOIN ecom_v1.returns r

    ) AS net_revenue

  JOIN order_revenue orv

WITH actual_revenue AS (

  JOIN ecom_v1.orders o

),
returns_by_item AS (

  FROM ecom_v1.returns r
  GROUP BY r.order_item_id
),
net_revenue AS (

    (ar.quantity - COALESCE(ri.total_qty_returned, 0)) * ar.unit_price_gross - ar.discount_amount AS net_revenue
  FROM actual_revenue ar
  LEFT JOIN returns_by_item ri
    ON ar.order_id = ri.order_item_id
  WHERE ar.order_status = 'completed'
    AND ar.order_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
)

  SUM(nr.net_revenue) AS total_revenue
FROM net_revenue nr
JOIN ecom_v1.customers c
  ON nr.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.segment
ORDER BY total_revenue ASC
